subject: social_studies
concept: Understanding social roles: every person in a group often has a job or role that helps the whole group
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student identifies their own role within their family or class
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a role (student, sibling, helper) to how it contributes to the group
exercise.abstract: Student explains their own role in a group and how it helps that group

misconception_flags: cannot identify any specific role they personally hold within a group

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
